title: Reject conflicting equal-generation DAO persistence slots
description: P2 correctness/robustness review: TwoSlotFilePersistence._get_best_slot silently selects slot 0 when both slots have the same valid generation, even if their sequence or payload differs. Equal-generation divergent records have no total order and can arise from legacy concurrent writers or corruption; choosing one can roll back TX/RX state. Treat divergent equal generations as corrupt and fail closed, while allowing identical duplicate records; add TX and RX coverage.
